title: Towards Building a Robust Toxicity Predictor
reasoning: The paper focuses on the adversarial robustness of toxicity classifiers. While the datasets and adversarial examples used contain hate speech targeting religious groups (e.g., Jews, anti-Christian sentiments), the paper's focus is on the technical methods of attack and defense (word-level perturbations and adversarial training) rather than benchmarking or evaluating religious or moral reasoning.
